title: Agricultural Pump Repair - Short Course
description: Eight week practical course covering pump dismantling, seal replacement, impeller repair, testing and workplace safety.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass. Practical experience is welcome but not required.

title: Workshop Technician - Farm Equipment Dealer
description: Workshop technician servicing tractors, tillers and pump sets at a dealership. Includes field visits within the taluka.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass with two years of repair experience, or a completed technician certificate.
source: Employer listing supplied by the district placement cell

title: Village Equipment Repair Enterprise
description: Supported pathway to set up a village level equipment repair service, combining technical upskilling with costing, spares and record keeping.
eligibility_notes: Resident of the block. Existing informal repair experience is counted.
